description: Backend data layer + pure SEO engine modules. Adds the guarded ADD-only SQL (prisma/seo-auto.sql), mirrors the new columns/tables into schema.prisma + prisma generate, extracts slugify to a shared util, wires SeoConfig.defaultLang through defaultSeoConfig/mergeSeoConfig/seoSchema, fixes the latent JSON-LD availability bug in buildProductJsonLd, and adds the pure (DB-free) generators/validators/scorers plus the integrations plumbing. Leaves api-node type-checking clean with no behavior change to existing routes. This feature is the foundation; FEAT-002 depends on its modules.
steps: Create api-node/prisma/seo-auto.sql following prisma/seo.sql exactly: for EACH new column use an information_schema COUNT guard + `SET @sql := IF(@c=0,'ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN ...','SELECT ''... already exists'' AS note'); PREPARE stmt FROM @sql; EXECUTE stmt; DEALLOCATE PREPARE stmt;`. products columns: seo_slug VARCHAR(200) NULL, seo_overrides JSON NULL, seo_auto_json JSON NULL, seo_score TINYINT UNSIGNED NULL, seo_problems JSON NULL, seo_generated_at DATETIME(3) NULL, seo_source_hash CHAR(40) NULL. categories columns: seo_title VARCHAR(255) NULL, seo_description TEXT NULL, seo_keywords VARCHAR(500) NULL, seo_intro TEXT NULL, og_image VARCHAR(500) NULL, seo_overrides JSON NULL, seo_auto_json JSON NULL, seo_score TINYINT UNSIGNED NULL, seo_problems JSON NULL, seo_generated_at DATETIME(3) NULL, seo_source_hash CHAR(40) NULL. Then CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS (InnoDB utf8mb4) for seo_jobs, seo_audit_log, seo_backups, seo_integrations with the exact columns + indexes in design.md section 4.3 (seo_integrations has UNIQUE(provider)).

Edit api-node/prisma/schema.prisma: add the new scalar fields (all optional `?`) to model Product and model Category, and add models SeoJob, SeoAuditLog, SeoBackup, SeoIntegration with @@map to seo_jobs/seo_audit_log/seo_backups/seo_integrations and column types matching the SQL (BigInt @db.UnsignedBigInt ids with @default(autoincrement()), VARCHAR/@db.Text/Json/DateTime as appropriate, indexes via @@index/@@unique). Mirror the Notification/NotificationRecipient model style already in the file.
Run `npx prisma generate` in api-node and confirm it succeeds.

Create api-node/src/utils/slug.ts exporting `export const slugify = (s: string) => ...` with the EXACT body currently inlined in routes/admin.ts; import it in routes/admin.ts and delete the local const (reuse, do not duplicate).

Edit api-node/src/seo/localSeo.ts: add `defaultLang: 'hi' | 'en'` to the SeoConfig interface; set `defaultLang: 'hi'` in defaultSeoConfig(); in mergeSeoConfig copy it as `defaultLang: r.defaultLang === 'en' ? 'en' : 'hi'`. In routes/admin.ts seoSchema add `defaultLang: z.enum(['hi','en']).optional()`.

Fix the latent bug in api-node/src/seo/localSeo.ts: add `in_stock?: boolean | null` to the ProductLike interface; in buildProductJsonLd set the Offer `availability` to `product.in_stock === false ? 'https://schema.org/OutOfStock' : 'https://schema.org/InStock'` (default InStock only when absent — parity with web/src/lib/seo.ts). Do NOT change the JSON-LD image argument.

Create api-node/src/seo/generate.ts (pure, no DB): export GeneratedProductSeo/GeneratedCategorySeo types, `generateProductSeo(product, cfg, categoryName?)`, `generateCategorySeo(category, memberProducts, cfg)`, the INDEXING_POLICY map (design section 6.7), and `sourceHash(entity)` (SHA-1 of ordered source fields). Title <=60 on a word boundary; description <=160; descHi/descEn + Hinglish keywords; keywords de-duped THEN capped to 500 chars on a comma boundary (never mid-token); slug via utils/slug.ts; imageAlt from real attributes only; canonical `${SITE_ORIGIN}/product/${id}`; availability/price strictly from DB, INR; never emit rating/review/discount; category intro lists real sample product names + real count, with an empty-category doorway guard (no intro). Reuse deriveProductSeo shape and the existing builders.

Create api-node/src/seo/validate.ts (pure): `validateProductSeo(generated, product, { existingTitles, existingSlugs })` -> { ok, problems[] } implementing every stable problem code from design section 5.2 (TITLE_EMPTY/TITLE_TOO_LONG/DESC_*/TITLE_DUP/DESC_DUP/SLUG_DUP/SLUG_UNSAFE/KEYWORDS_IRRELEVANT/CANONICAL_BAD/AVAILABILITY_MISMATCH/PRICE_MISMATCH/IMAGE_MISSING_ALT/BLOCKED_PUBLIC/SPAMMY/FABRICATION) with recoverable-vs-fatal semantics, the banned-claims FABRICATION regex (sabse sasta, cheapest, lowest price, #1, best price, guaranteed, 100% organic unless verified, review/rating words), and AVAILABILITY_MISMATCH recomputed from DB in_stock. Add a validateCategorySeo variant minus price/availability.

Create api-node/src/seo/completeness.ts (pure): exported tunable `SCORE_WEIGHTS` (the design section 5.4 table, summing to 100) and `ATTENTION_THRESHOLD = 80`; `scoreProduct(product, generated, problems)` and `scoreCategory(...)` -> { score: 0..100, problems: string[] }; and a single exported `needsAttention(score, problems)` predicate (score < ATTENTION_THRESHOLD OR non-empty problems).

Create api-node/src/seo/dedupe.ts: `findDuplicates()` (GROUP BY queries over products' effective seo_title/seo_description/seo_slug) and `keywordMap()` (anti-cannibalization: best page per primary keyword, demote weaker). GSC volume/position/competition are returned as `unavailable` and NEVER fabricated.

Create api-node/src/seo/integrations.ts (PHASE-2 safe no-op): `getIntegrationStatus(provider)`, `connect(provider, payload)`, `disconnect(provider)` reading seo_integrations rows + presence of server-side env creds (e.g. SEO_GSC_CLIENT_SECRET); return connected|disconnected|error + non-secret account_ref only; no-op with a clear 'not connected' message when creds absent; NEVER return secrets, NEVER fabricate numbers.
Add `buildItemListJsonLd(items)` to api-node/src/seo/localSeo.ts (used later by the category OG route in FEAT-002) following the buildBreadcrumbJsonLd style.
acceptance_criteria: Running `npx tsc --noEmit` in api-node exits 0 with the new modules present.
Running `npx prisma generate` in api-node succeeds after the schema.prisma edits.
prisma/seo-auto.sql follows the information_schema-guarded ADD COLUMN pattern of prisma/seo.sql and uses CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS for the four new tables.
buildProductJsonLd emits availability OutOfStock when in_stock === false and InStock otherwise/when absent.
generate.ts/validate.ts/completeness.ts/dedupe.ts contain no fabricated price/stock/rating/claim output and the FABRICATION regex blocks the banned claim words.
slugify is defined once in utils/slug.ts and imported by admin.ts (no duplicate const).
verification: Run `npx tsc --noEmit` in api-node — must exit 0.
Run `npx prisma generate` in api-node — must succeed.
findings:
FEAT-001 landed. VERIFICATION: `npx tsc --noEmit` in api-node exits 0; `npx prisma generate` succeeds (Prisma Client v5.22.0). Note: the worktree had no node_modules — ran `npm ci` to install, and prisma's engine binary could not be re-downloaded (TLS/403), so the v5.22.0 engine binaries were copied from the sibling parent workspace node_modules and `prisma generate` was run with PRISMA_QUERY_ENGINE_LIBRARY / PRISMA_SCHEMA_ENGINE_BINARY pointing at them; generation itself succeeded against the schema.

EXPORTS FOR FEAT-002:

src/utils/slug.ts: `export const slugify = (s: string) => string` (extracted from admin.ts; admin.ts now imports it).

src/seo/localSeo.ts (extended): SeoConfig now has `defaultLang: 'hi' | 'en'` (defaultSeoConfig sets 'hi'; mergeSeoConfig copies `r.defaultLang === 'en' ? 'en' : 'hi'`). ProductLike now has `in_stock?: boolean | null`. buildProductJsonLd Offer.availability = in_stock===false ? OutOfStock : InStock. NEW: `export interface ItemListEntry { name: string; url: string }` and `export function buildItemListJsonLd(items: ItemListEntry[])`. admin.ts seoSchema gained `defaultLang: z.enum(['hi','en']).optional()`.

src/seo/generate.ts (pure): types `GeneratedProductSeo` { title, description, descHi, descEn, keywords, slug, imageAlt, canonical, indexing }, `GeneratedCategorySeo` { title, description, intro, keywords, slug, imageAlt, canonical, indexing }, `CategoryLike` { id?, name, slug?, image?, og_image? }, `IndexingDirective = 'index,follow' | 'noindex,nofollow'`. Consts: `INDEXING_POLICY: Record<string, IndexingDirective>`. Fns: `clampWords(text, max): string`, `dedupeAndCapKeywords(tokens: string[], max=500): string`, `sourceHash(entity: Record<string, unknown>): string`, `productSourceHash(product: ProductLike): string`, `categorySourceHash(category: CategoryLike, memberProducts: ProductLike[]): string`, `generateProductSeo(product: ProductLike, cfg: SeoConfig, categoryName?: string): GeneratedProductSeo`, `generateCategorySeo(category: CategoryLike, memberProducts: ProductLike[], cfg: SeoConfig): GeneratedCategorySeo`. NOTE: `ProblemCode` is exported from validate.ts (NOT generate.ts).

src/seo/validate.ts (pure): type `ProblemCode` (all design 5.2 codes), `FATAL_CODES: ReadonlySet<ProblemCode>` = {CANONICAL_BAD, BLOCKED_PUBLIC, FABRICATION}, `ValidationResult { ok: boolean; problems: ProblemCode[] }`, `ProductValidationContext { existingTitles?: Set<string>; existingSlugs?: Set<string> }`, `CategoryValidationContext` (same shape). Fns: `validateProductSeo(generated: GeneratedProductSeo, product: ProductLike, ctx?: ProductValidationContext): ValidationResult`, `checkDbTruth(product: ProductLike, emitted: { availability?: string|null; price?: string|number|null }): ProblemCode[]` (DEVIATION/addition: AVAILABILITY_MISMATCH + PRICE_MISMATCH are computed here from the actually-emitted JSON-LD offer rather than inside validateProductSeo, since the pure validator does not build JSON-LD; call checkDbTruth with the built Offer and merge its codes), `validateCategorySeo(generated: GeneratedCategorySeo, ctx?: CategoryValidationContext): ValidationResult`. existingTitles Set also carries description dupes keyed `desc:<lowercased>` (DESC_DUP lookup).

src/seo/completeness.ts (pure): `SCORE_WEIGHTS` {title:20,description:20,dbTruth:15,keywords:10,slug:10,image:10,canonical:10,indexing:5} (sum 100), `ATTENTION_THRESHOLD = 80`, `ScoreResult { score: number; problems: string[] }`, `scoreProduct(product: ProductLike, generated: GeneratedProductSeo, problems: ProblemCode[]): ScoreResult`, `scoreCategory(generated: GeneratedCategorySeo, problems: ProblemCode[], hasImage?=false): ScoreResult`, `needsAttention(score: number, problems: string[] | null | undefined): boolean`.

src/seo/dedupe.ts (DB): `DuplicateGroup { value: string; ids: string[] }`, `DuplicateReport { titles; descriptions; slugs }`, `findDuplicates(): Promise<DuplicateReport>` (GROUP BY over seo_title/seo_description/seo_slug), `KeywordWinner { keyword; bestProductId; demotedProductIds; volume:'unavailable'; position:'unavailable'; competition:'unavailable' }`, `keywordMap(): Promise<KeywordWinner[]>`.

src/seo/integrations.ts (DB + env): types `IntegrationProvider = 'gsc'|'ga4'|'gbp'`, `IntegrationState = 'connected'|'disconnected'|'error'`, `IntegrationStatus { provider; status; accountRef; lastSyncAt; lastError; credsPresent; message }`, `ConnectPayload { accountRef?: string|null }`. Fns: `getIntegrationStatus(provider: string): Promise<IntegrationStatus>`, `connect(provider: string, payload?: ConnectPayload): Promise<IntegrationStatus>`, `disconnect(provider: string): Promise<IntegrationStatus>`. Cred env names: gsc=SEO_GSC_CLIENT_SECRET, ga4=SEO_GA4_PROPERTY_ID, gbp=SEO_GBP_CLIENT_SECRET (presence only; secrets never returned). Safe no-op when creds absent.

PRISMA MODELS ADDED (schema.prisma, @@map): SeoJob -> seo_jobs, SeoAuditLog -> seo_audit_log, SeoBackup -> seo_backups, SeoIntegration -> seo_integrations. New Product columns: seo_slug, seo_overrides(Json), seo_auto_json(Json), seo_score(Int @db.UnsignedTinyInt), seo_problems(Json), seo_generated_at(DateTime @db.DateTime(3)), seo_source_hash(Char(40)). New Category columns: seo_title, seo_description, seo_keywords, seo_intro, og_image, seo_overrides, seo_auto_json, seo_score, seo_problems, seo_generated_at, seo_source_hash. SQL: prisma/seo-auto.sql (guarded ADD COLUMN + CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS).

DEVIATIONS FROM DESIGN: (1) checkDbTruth split out of validateProductSeo as noted above. (2) descHi/descEn are both always generated; `description` picks per cfg.defaultLang. No other behavioral deviations.
